title: fix(mcp): run_action takes the face list_actions lists, so an action bound to several objects runs by its listed row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAUev5V62cLHhQwBi

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：MCP 的 `run_action` 现在接受 `list_actions` 每行给出的 face（如 `sys_member-invite_user`）作为 `actionName`，按调用者自己的动作列表解析成「名字 + 对象 + 命名空间」后执行那一个绑定；两个工具的描述写明「同名多行时传 face」。
- 为什么改：平台把 `invite_user` 绑在四个系统对象上，列表正确地列出四行，但裸名执行被判歧义，而每行唯一能区分自己的 face 传给 `run_action` 却答 404，AI 只能猜（#32437）。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽：原来 404 的 face 现在能执行。带 objectName 的调用、唯一裸名、歧义裸名的答案都不变；列表里没有的 face 仍答 404，face 与显式 objectName/namespace 冲突答 400。只改 `packages/mcp`，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `resolveActionFace` 与 `run_action` 处理函数开头；`packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts`，预期 25 条全绿，其中「run_action takes a listed face」一组 11 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32437

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` names `list_actions` / `run_action` without a disambiguation rule and stays true.

**Widening, FROM → TO.** `run_action({ actionName: FACE })`, FACE being a face `list_actions` lists,: FROM `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (404, "Action 'sys_user-invite_user' not found"), nothing run → TO that one binding runs, by its name, `objectName` and `namespace`. Nothing that ran before runs differently. A `-`-bearing call that was refused stays refused, with the tool's own answer: a face that disagrees with a given `objectName` or `namespace` now answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400, and an unlisted face answers `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` 404 from the tool instead of the runtime's wording (corrected per contract review on this head, should-fix).

## What changes

- `run_action` reads an `actionName` that contains `-` as an ADR-0150 D6 face. No action name admits `-` (`SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema`), and every face form carries one, so a face never collides with a name, and a name takes the old path byte for byte.
- The face is read back against the caller's own `list_actions` rows, with the listing's visibility filter (`isListableAction`) and its refused-face rule (`faceListOfActions`), so `run_action` accepts exactly the faces `list_actions` hands that caller. The resolved `{ name, objectName, namespace }` goes to the bridge unchanged, so every runtime gate (exposure, capability, confirmation, record load) runs as for a call by name.
- A face no visible row carries, or one the listing refuses as shared, answers `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (404) and nothing runs; the shared case quotes the listing's reason. A face sent with an `objectName` or `namespace` naming another binding answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400) and nothing runs.
- Both tool descriptions, and the `actionName` field description, now say that when a name is listed on several rows the caller passes the row's face (or the name with the row's `objectName` and `namespace`). `packages/mcp/README.md` says the same.
- Not changed: the listing's rows, the runtime's by-name resolution and its ambiguity refusal (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts`), either bridge, and `describe_object`.

Why not resolve "the same operation" automatically: measured, the four `invite_user` bindings are not one operation (the `sys_organization` one is record-scoped, `recordIdParam: 'organizationId'`), and the two `add_team_member` bindings take different params. The seat declined that option (claim amendment 6811809676).

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts` (the action tools' shared harness), through the HTTP `/mcp` door of `MCPServerRuntime` with a recording bridge that models the platform's four `invite_user` bindings and the runtime's ambiguity refusal:

- a listed face runs its one binding, and the bridge receives `invite_user` with `objectName: 'sys_member'`, `namespace: 'sys'` and the params;
- the record-scoped twin's face (`sys_organization-invite_user`) runs that binding with its `recordId`;
- a face no listed row carries → 404, nothing runs;
- the face of a `sys_*` action not exposed to AI (the listing withholds it) → 404, nothing runs;
- a face the listing refuses as shared → 404 naming why, nothing runs;
- a face with a disagreeing `objectName`, and one with a disagreeing `namespace` → 400, nothing runs;
- a face with its own `objectName` and `namespace` runs;
- CONTROL: a name with `objectName` reaches the bridge as before, with no `namespace` key;
- CONTROL: a unique bare name reaches the bridge as before and the listing is never read;
- CONTROL: an ambiguous bare name still answers the runtime's `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

## Acceptance notes

- The runtime's ambiguity sentence still says "pass objectName to disambiguate". It is true (that call runs) and lives in `runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, outside this card's surface and under open PR #32327; not changed here.
- Seat A's #32435 edits the `describe_object` block of the same file; this PR does not touch it. Whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Verification

All readings on head `b75db7915` (this branch with `origin/main` `c6230f4ee` merged) unless named.

<details><summary>Through the real door, before and after (showcase + MCPServerPlugin, administrator session, live /api/v1/mcp)</summary>

A throwaway dogfood file, never committed. Before, on `main` `e765a092`: `list_actions` 38 rows, `invite_user` ×4 (`sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_member`, `sys_invitation`) and `add_team_member` ×2, every row with `namespace: "sys"` and its own face. `run_action({ actionName: 'invite_user' })` → `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400 "exists on multiple objects (…); pass objectName to disambiguate". `run_action({ actionName: 'sys_user-invite_user' })` → `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` 404 "Action 'sys_user-invite_user' not found". CONTROL with `objectName: 'sys_member'` → `ok: true`, invitation pending.

After, on `c005e0a8` (the fix, `@objectstack/mcp` rebuilt): the listing and the bare-name refusal are unchanged; `run_action({ actionName: 'sys_user-invite_user' })` → `ok: true`, `action: "invite_user"`, `objectName: "sys_user"`, invitation pending; the `objectName` CONTROL unchanged.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the face resolution)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts --anchor "        if (isActionFace(actionName)) {" --replacement "        if (/* ABLATED_32437 */ false && isActionFace(actionName)) {"`: mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob `faa02b5a9788` → `2a21f1c7fd64`); `mcp-action-tools.test.ts` → 7 failed | 18 passed: every face pin red (the face run → `sys_member` system-object refusal / 404; the unlisted, hidden and shared faces → not the 404 envelope; the disagreeing face → no `VALIDATION_ERROR`), the three CONTROLs and every older test green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The first attempt used an undeclared identifier as the replacement, which threw a `ReferenceError` and reddened the CONTROLs too; it was discarded as not an ablation of the behaviour.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, lint</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` → Test Files 63 passed, Tests 1052 passed (on `c005e0a8`; the later commits change only the face pins' typing and merge `ui/` and docs files); `mcp-action-tools.test.ts` 25/25 on the final tree.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` → exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` OK (6 files / 53 errors held in the ledger, unchanged).
- `pnpm lint` → exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 65)</summary>

All 65 exit 0 on `b75db7915`, codes captured before any pipe; `dispatch-gates --ran` → "65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". On the first run (`c005e0a8`) two exited 3 (prerequisite not met: a shallow history for `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, missing `dist/` for `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`); both exit 0 on the final run after `git fetch` of the history and the dogfood closure build.
</details>
